subject: DI05019021

body.en:
Definition / principle

Air-conditioning controls selected temperature, moisture, cleanliness and air-motion conditions for comfort or a process.

Understand why

By purpose:comfort and industrial/process; by season:summer, winter, year-round.

By arrangement:room(window/split), packaged and central systems; by air supply:fresh, recirculated, mixed.

Examples:homes/offices for comfort, laboratories/server rooms/manufacturing for specified process conditions.

Cooling alone is not full air-conditioning; ventilation is a separate outdoor-air requirement and needs explicit provision.

Does every splitACprovide fresh air?

No. Standard room systems commonly recirculate indoor air.

Is RH the mass fraction of water?

No. It is vapour partial pressure divided by saturation pressure at the same temperature.
body.gu:

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Examples:homes/offices comfort;laboratories/server rooms/manufacturing specified process conditions.

ફક્ત cooling full air-conditioning નહિ;ventilation separate outdoor-air requirement છે,explicit provision જોઈએ.

દરેક Split AC Fresh Air આપે?

ના.Standard room systems સામાન્ય રીતે indoor air recirculate કરે.

RH Waterનો Mass Fraction છે?

ના.Same temperatureમાં vapour partial pressure/saturation pressure છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Moist air is a mixture of dry air and water vapour; psychrometric quantities usually use a dry-air mass basis.

Understand why

DBT:ordinary shielded dry-bulb temperature; WBT:ventilated wetted-sensor temperature; DPT:temperature at which condensation begins on cooling at constant moisture content.

Humidity ratio w=mass of vapour/mass of dry air, kg/kgdryair; relative humidityphi=pv/pws(T).

Degree of saturation=w/wsat is not generally identical tophi; specific humidity on a moist-air basis=w/(1+w).

Enthalpyh(kJ/kgdryair)and specific volumev(m³/kgdryair)need the same mass basis in calculations.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Humidity ratio w=vapour mass/dry-air mass,kg/kg dry air;relative humidity phi=pv/pws(T).

Degree of saturation w/wsat સામાન્ય રીતે phi સમાન નહિ;moist-air basis specific humidity w/(1+w).

Enthalpy h(kJ/kg dry air),specific volume v(m³/kg dry air)માં same mass basis રાખો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Measure enough independent properties and barometric pressure before calculating the state.

Understand why

A dry-bulb sensor must avoid direct radiant/wetting error; wet-bulb measurement needs a clean wetted wick and suitable airflow.

A psychrometer uses dry/wet-bulb data with a pressure-appropriate chart or equation; do not readRHfrom temperature difference alone without context.

Electronic capacitive/resistive hygrometers sense humidity; dew-point instruments detect condensation conditions by an appropriate method.

Calibration, stabilisation, sensor placement, contamination and pressure influence results; record actual observations only.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A psychrometer determines moist-air conditions from dry- and wet-bulb measurements with a suitable pressure-based relation.

Classification / types — basis first

  • Temperature/humidity instruments include dry/wet-bulb psychrometers, electronic hygrometers and dew-point instruments. Psychrometers may be sling or aspirated; this is a measurement classification, not a refrigeration-system classification.

Construction — each part and its purpose

  1. Two calibrated temperature sensors are positioned to sample the same representative air.
  2. The dry bulb is shielded from direct radiation and unintended wetting.
  3. The wet bulb has a clean water-wetted wick making good thermal contact with the sensor; water quality and wick condition matter.
  4. A sling motion or aspirating fan provides suitable ventilation; the correct chart/equation also needs barometric pressure.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Representative air flows over both sensors under approved instrument conditions.
  2. Water evaporation cools the wet bulb until coupled heat/mass transfer reaches a stable condition.
  3. For ordinary unsaturated air, WBT is below DBT; at saturated equilibrium they coincide.
  4. Read stable dry/wet temperatures and pressure; locate the state using a pressure-appropriate chart or relation to obtain humidity.
  5. Inspect sensor calibration, wick contamination and ventilation if results are implausible; temperature difference alone without pressure/method context is not a universal RH scale.

Application / advantages

Air-property practicals, comfort assessment and cooling-process state measurement.

Common mistake / conditions

No laboratory readings are invented; protect instruments and follow approved procedures, especially near moving fans or electrical equipment.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Psychrometer dry/wet-bulb measurements,suitable pressure-based relationથી moist-air condition શોધે.

Classification / Types — પહેલાં Basis

  • Instruments dry/wet-bulb psychrometer,electronic hygrometer,dew-point instrument.Psychrometer sling/aspirated;આ measurement classification છે,refrigeration systemsની નહિ.

Construction — દરેક ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. બે calibrated temperature sensors same representative air sample કરે.
  2. Dry bulb direct radiation,અનિચ્છિત wettingથી shield હોય.
  3. Wet bulbમાં sensor સાથે સારો contact ધરાવતી clean wetted wick;water quality,wick condition મહત્વની.
  4. Sling motion/aspirating fan suitable ventilation આપે;chart/equation માટે barometric pressure પણ જોઈએ.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Approved instrument conditionsમાં representative air બન્ને sensors પરથી જાય.
  2. Water evaporation wet bulb cool કરે જ્યાં સુધી heat/mass transfer stable ન થાય.
  3. Ordinary unsaturated airમાં WBT,DBTથી નીચે;saturated equilibriumમાં બન્ને same.
  4. Stable dry/wet temperatures,pressure લો;appropriate chart/relationથી humidity મેળવો.
  5. Result અસંભવ લાગે તો calibration,wick,ventilation તપાસો;ફક્ત difference universal RH scale નહિ.

Application / લાભ

Air-property practicals,comfort assessment,cooling-process state measurement.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Lab readings invent નથી;moving fans/electrical equipment પાસે approved procedures લો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Choose a chart for the stated total pressure; the schematic here is not a numerical chart.

Understand why

DBT increases to the right; humidity ratio increases upward; saturation is a curved boundary.

Use two independent properties at known pressure to locate a state and readh, w, RH, WBT, DPT, v.

Dew point is found by moving horizontally to saturation at constantw; heating without adding water reducesRHbut keepswunchanged.

Enthalpy and wet-bulb lines are close over common ranges but are not exactly the same property.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Stated total pressureનું chart લો;અહીં schematic numerical chart નથી.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

DBT જમણે વધે;humidity ratio ઉપર વધે;saturation curved boundary.

Known pressureમાં બે independent propertiesથી state locate કરીને h,w,RH,WBT,DPT,v વાંચો.

Constant w horizontalથી saturation સુધી જતાં dew point;water ઉમેર્યા વગર heatingમાં RH ઘટે,w same.

Common rangesમાં enthalpy,wet-bulb lines નજીક,પણ exact same property નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Sensible processes changeDBTwithout changing humidity ratio when no condensation/moisture transfer occurs.

Understand why

Heating moves right horizontally at constantw; RH falls because saturation pressure increases.

Cooling above dew point moves left horizontally; RH rises until saturation is reached.

Qdot≈mdotda(1.005+1.88w)ΔT for this approximation; use sign convention or report heating/cooling magnitude explicitly.

Cooling below dew point usually removes moisture and no longer follows a constantwline.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Condensation/moisture transfer ન હોય ત્યારે sensible process DBT બદલે,w નહિ.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Heating constant wમાં horizontal right; saturation pressure વધતાં RH ઘટે.

Dew pointથી ઉપર cooling horizontal left; saturation સુધી RH વધે.

Approximationમાં Qdot≈mdotda(1.005+1.88w)ΔT;sign convention/heat magnitude સ્પષ્ટ લખો.

Dew pointની નીચે સામાન્ય રીતે moisture remove થાય,constant w line રહેતી નથી.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Describe both temperature direction and moisture direction; one label alone may hide the energy input.

Understand why

Cooling and dehumidification moves generally left/down across a wet cooling coil; condensate rate=mdotda(w1−w2).

Adiabatic evaporative cooling moves left/up approximately along constanth:DBT falls, w rises; it cannot lowerDBTbelow the relevant wet-bulb limit in the simple model.

Steam humidification adds moisture and enthalpy; dehumidification by desiccant often adds sensible heat and needs regeneration.

Reheat after cooling/dehumidification raisesDBTat nearly constantw; RH may change without reversing the moisture removal.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Temperature,moisture direction બન્ને લખો;ફક્ત label energy input છુપાવે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Wet coilમાં cooling/dehumidification generally left/down;condensate rate=mdotda(w1−w2).

Adiabatic evaporative cooling લગભગ constant hમાં left/up;DBT ઘટે,w વધે;simple modelમાં relevant WBTથી નીચે નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

For adiabatic mixing without condensation, conserve dry-air mass, vapour and enthalpy.

Understand why

mdot3=mdot1+mdot2 on the dry-air basis.

w3=(mdot1w1+mdot2w2)/(mdot1+mdot2); h3 has the same weighted form.

The mixed state lies on the joining line in the appropriate psychrometric coordinates; do not averageRHdirectly.

If the result implies supersaturation/condensation, the simple no-condensation model needs an additional liquid-water balance.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Classify loads by source and as sensible/latent before summing them.

Understand why

External:wall/roof/window conduction, solar gain and outdoor air; internal:people, lights, equipment and process heat.

Sensible load changes temperature; latent load involves moisture removal/addition. People and outdoor air can contribute both.

For a simple conduction termQ=UAΔT; real solar/time-dependent building loads need appropriate design methods.

Qtotal=Qsensible+Qlatent; SHR=Qsensible/Qtotal. Do not double-count infiltration as both leakage and already included ventilation.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Simple conduction Q=UAΔT;real solar/time-dependent loadsમાં appropriate methods જોઈએ.

Qtotal=Qsensible+Qlatent;SHR=Qsensible/Qtotal.Infiltrationને leakage અને included ventilation બન્નેમાં double-count નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A single cabinet contains the room-side evaporator and outdoor-side heat-rejection equipment separated by a partition.

Classification / types — basis first

  • Window AC is a unitary room arrangement; systems may use fixed-speed or inverter control. Cooling-only and reverse-cycle heat-pump versions are functional categories, not the same classification as window versus split.

Construction — each part and its purpose

  1. A common cabinet is divided by a partition into room-side and outdoor-side air sections, preventing unwanted mixing.
  2. Room side contains a filter, evaporator and blower to recirculate room air over the cold coil.
  3. Outdoor side contains condenser and outdoor fan to release heat; the compressor is normally outside the room air path.
  4. Capillary or other approved expansion device, filter-drier and tubing form the sealed refrigerant loop.
  5. Thermostat/electronic control, sensors, fan controls and protective devices manage operation.
  6. Condensate tray and designed drainage handle water removed from humid air; installation support and sealing limit leakage/vibration.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. The indoor blower draws room air through the filter and across the evaporator.
  2. Air gives sensible heat to the coil; when the surface is below dew point, moisture also condenses and drains.
  3. Refrigerant evaporates, returns as vapour to the compressor and is compressed to condenser pressure.
  4. Outdoor air carries away condenser heat, which equals indoor cooling plus energy input within the stated boundary.
  5. Liquid refrigerant throttles back to evaporator pressure; control cycles/modulates capacity and fans as designed.
  6. The room and outdoor air streams remain separate; any ventilation provision is explicit and not assumed from the existence of an outdoor fan.

Application / advantages

Compact factory-assembled room cooling; no long field refrigerant-line connection is needed for a conventional unitary cabinet.

Common mistake / conditions

Requires a suitable wall/window opening, weather sealing, airflow and drain arrangement; indoor noise and placement constraints may exceed split systems.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Single cabinetમાં partitionથી room-side evaporator,outdoor-side heat rejection અલગ.

Classification / Types — પહેલાં Basis

  • Window AC unitary room arrangement;fixed-speed/inverter control હોઈ શકે.Cooling-only/reverse-cycle heat-pump functional categories છે,window/split જેવી basis નહિ.

Construction — દરેક ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Common cabinetમાં partition room/outdoor air sections અલગ રાખે જેથી unwanted mixing ન થાય.
  2. Room sideમાં filter,evaporator,blower;room air cold coil પરથી recirculate થાય.
  3. Outdoorમાં condenser,fan heat છોડે;compressor સામાન્ય room air path બહાર.
  4. Capillary/approved expansion device,filter-drier,tubing sealed refrigerant loop બનાવે.
  5. Thermostat/electronic control,sensors,fan controls,protection operation manage કરે.
  6. Condensate tray,designed drain removed water સંભાળે;support,sealing leakage/vibration ઘટાડે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Indoor blower room air filter,cold evaporator પરથી ખેંચે.
  2. Air sensible heat આપે;surface dew pointથી નીચે હોય તો moisture condense,drain થાય.
  3. Refrigerant evaporate, vapour compressorમાં,પછી condenser pressure સુધી compress.
  4. Outdoor air condenser heat લઈ જાય;તે indoor cooling+stated energy input.
  5. Liquid throttle થઈ evaporator pressureએ;control capacity,fans cycle/modulate કરે.
  6. Room,outdoor air separate;ventilation explicit provision છે,outdoor fan હોવાથી assume નહિ.

Application / લાભ

Compact factory-assembled room cooling;conventional cabinetમાં long field refrigerant lines નહિ.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Suitable opening,weather seal,airflow,drain જોઈએ;indoor noise,placement constraints split કરતાં વધુ હોઈ શકે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A split system separates indoor and outdoor assemblies connected by refrigerant lines and control/electrical services.

Classification / types — basis first

  • By indoor arrangement:wall-mounted, cassette, ducted and other units; single-split versus multi-split concerns outdoor/indoor connections. Fixed-speed/inverter and cooling-only/heat-pump are additional separate bases.

Construction — each part and its purpose

  1. Indoor unit contains filter, evaporator coil, blower, air-direction louvers, sensor and condensate tray/drain in cooling mode.
  2. Outdoor unit contains compressor, condenser and fan, with power/control and protective hardware.
  3. Refrigerant piping connects the units with suitable insulation and design-limited lengths/lifts; it carries refrigerant, not a fresh-air supply.
  4. Expansion device location depends on equipment; do not assume every system has the same liquid/two-phase line condition.
  5. Electrical/control connections coordinate indoor and outdoor functions; inverter electronics vary compressor motor speed where fitted.
  6. Heat-pump versions include a reversing arrangement and suitable controls; the indoor/outdoor coil duties then change with mode.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Room air is filtered and blown over the cooling-mode indoor evaporator.
  2. Refrigerant absorbs heat; water condenses if coil conditions are below dew point and exits via a separate drain.
  3. Vapour flows through the suction path to the outdoor compressor, which provides pressure lift.
  4. Condenser and outdoor airflow reject heat; refrigerant then passes the designed expansion path and returns to the indoor evaporator.
  5. Control adjusts cycling or inverter speed to demand; lower speed is not a different refrigeration principle.
  6. Reverse-cycle operation where fitted changes heat-flow duty; ordinary recirculating split AC still does not automatically meet fresh-air ventilation needs.

Application / advantages

Lower indoor compressor noise and flexible placement; ducted/multi-split layouts serve different room arrangements.

Common mistake / conditions

Needs qualified installation, correct line sizing/insulation, drainage and electrical/refrigerant protection; it is not universally more efficient under every selection and operating condition.

Can a room-load sum determine electrical input directly?

No. Cooling capacity and electrical input differ; system efficiency is needed.

Definition / Principle

Split systemમાં indoor,outdoor assemblies refrigerant lines,control/electrical servicesથી જોડાય.

Classification / Types — પહેલાં Basis

  • Indoor arrangement wall-mounted,cassette,ducted વગેરે;single/multi-split connectionsની basis.Fixed-speed/inverter,cooling-only/heat-pump અલગ bases.

Construction — દરેક ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Cooling mode indoor unitમાં filter,evaporator,blower,louvers,sensor,condensate tray/drain.
  2. Outdoorમાં compressor,condenser,fan,power/control,protection.
  3. Suitable insulated piping units જોડે;length/lift limits design મુજબ;તે refrigerant લઈ જાય,fresh air નહિ.
  4. Expansion device location equipment મુજબ;દરેક systemમાં same line condition assume નહિ.
  5. Electrical/control connections functions coordinate કરે;fitted inverter compressor speed બદલે.
  6. Heat-pumpમાં reversing arrangement,controls;modeથી coil duties બદલાય.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Cooling modeમાં room air filter થઈ indoor evaporator પરથી જાય.
  2. Refrigerant heat લે;dew pointથી નીચે water condense થઈ separate drainથી જાય.
  3. Vapour suction pathથી outdoor compressorમાં;ત્યાં pressure lift મળે.
  4. Condenser,outdoor airflow heat છોડે;refrigerant designed expansion pathથી indoor evaporatorમાં પાછું.
  5. Control demand પ્રમાણે cycling/inverter speed બદલે;lower speed અલગ refrigeration principle નહિ.
  6. Fitted reverse-cycleમાં heat-flow duty બદલાય;ordinary recirculating split AC આપમેળે fresh-air need પૂરી નહિ કરે.

Application / લાભ

Indoor compressor noise ઓછી,placement flexible;ducted/multi-split અલગ arrangements આપે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Qualified installation,line sizing/insulation,drain,electrical/refrigerant protection જોઈએ;દરેક conditionમાં universally efficient નહિ.

Room-load Sumથી Electrical Input સીધું મળે?

ના.Cooling capacity,electrical input અલગ;system efficiency જોઈએ.
